contents.counting_method: YAML-parsed list items per data/<state>/local/*.yml. Do NOT count with `grep -c '^- name:'` - see resolved_discrepancies.

resolved_discrepancies.note: RESOLVED - the gap was OUR counting bug, not missing data. The 18534 figure came from `grep -c '^- name:'`, which misses 1203 records that list `id` before `name` (YAML key order is not fixed). 18534 + 1203 = 19737, which is exactly what live civicpatch.org/api/v1 serves. Their API and their repo agree. Every per_state count above was undercounted the same way and has been recalculated by YAML parse. Do not report this to Civic Data Tech as a defect. Detail: .planning/decisions/2026-08-04-civicpatch-snapshot-diff.md

why_data_source_excluded: data_source/<state>/local/place_*/workflow_context.json is 2781 files / 188 MB - 89% of the clone by size. It holds the scraper's LLM pipeline internals (page content, per-LLM merge steps, review steps), not row provenance. Provenance we rely on (source_urls, updated_at) is carried in the data/ YAML itself, so excluding it loses nothing the importer or an audit needs.
